full_prompt_en: A square, loosely painted anime-style illustration shows young women walking through a broad city street under bright blue daylight. The background opens to a pale sky filled with broken cream clouds, while a slender dark spire rises at the far right. Stone façades, steps, and distant pedestrians recede along both sides of the roadway. The central street is a wide patchwork of icy blue, warm cream, and gray, with rectangular paving marks visible beneath the figures. In the foreground, a dark-haired young woman stands just left of center with her back mostly to the viewer. She wears a pale short-sleeved blouse, a dark blue skirt, high dark socks, and a shoulder bag that hangs beside her hip. Two other young women in similarly cool blue and white clothing occupy the space to her right, one turning slightly toward the group and another seen more from behind. Smaller walkers and a bicycle-like shape populate the middle distance without competing with the main figures. Their legs cast long blue-gray shadows toward the lower edge, tying their upright silhouettes to the pale ground. The camera looks from pedestrian height and gives the foreground group space against a broad luminous opening. Thick and thin brush marks remain visible throughout: quick dark lines catch hair, clothing seams, and building edges, while wider broken patches create sunlit masonry and pavement. The light comes from high behind the group, bleaching parts of the sky and road and outlining shoulders and hair with warm white. The overall composition feels airy and in motion, using cool blue masses, scattered warm highlights, and a loose perspective path to carry the eye through the passing crowd.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、笔触松动的动漫式插画描绘几名年轻女子在明亮蓝色日光下走过宽阔的城市街道。背景向浅色天空敞开，天空中有断续的奶油色云块，最右侧远处升起一座纤细深色尖塔。石质立面、台阶和远处行人沿道路两侧后退。中央街面由冰蓝、暖奶油色和灰色块拼成宽阔的区域，人物脚下还能看出矩形铺路痕迹。前景中央偏左，一位深发年轻女子大体背向观者站着。她穿浅色短袖上衣、深蓝短裙和高筒深色袜子，肩包垂在身侧。另外两位穿相近蓝白衣服的年轻女子占据她右边的空间，一位略向同伴转身，另一位更多从背后被看见。中景的其他行人与一处类似自行车的形状为街道增添活动，却不与主角群组争夺注意力。她们的腿向下缘投出长长的蓝灰色影子，把直立剪影连接到浅色地面。镜头处于行人高度，使前景群组立在宽阔发亮的开口前。粗细交替的笔痕遍布画面：快速深线标出头发、衣服接缝和建筑边缘，更宽的断续色块构成受光石墙与路面。光从群组后方高处照来，漂白天空和路面的部分区域，并用暖白色勾亮肩膀与头发。整体构图通透且有运动感，以冷蓝色体块、零散暖亮部和松散的透视道路，把视线带过走动的人群。
style_prompt_en: The painted illustration mixes animation-like shape clarity with visibly broken, textured brushwork. Icy blue and blue-gray dominate broad planes; cream, muted gold, and occasional warm rust marks open the light. Dark lines are selective and quick, defining focal edges while letting distant structures fragment into color patches. Near figures are distinct but not uniformly polished, and smaller marks compress into the airy distance. Strong daylight blows out some high-value areas and produces long cool shadows, giving the pale ground a rhythmic pattern. Vertical silhouettes punctuate a loose converging route, so depth feels lively rather than rigid. Matte paint grain and overlapping strokes keep surfaces tactile. The overall effect is bright and mobile, combining clean narrative readability with expressive painterly atmosphere.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画插画把动漫般清楚的形状与可见的断续、带肌理笔触结合起来。冰蓝和蓝灰主导大片平面，奶油色、暗金色与偶尔的暖铁锈色笔迹打开光亮。深色线条有选择地迅速落下，界定焦点边缘，又让远处结构碎成色斑。近处形体分明，却没有处处磨光，较小笔迹则压缩进通透远景。强日光使一些高明度区域接近漂白，并造成长长的冷色阴影，让浅色地面有节奏性纹样。直立剪影打断松散汇聚的路线，因此纵深显得活泼而非僵硬。哑光颜料颗粒和重叠笔触保留表面的触感。整体效果明亮而富于移动感，将清楚的叙事可读性与表现性的绘画气氛结合起来。
theme_en: Young women walking through a sunlit blue city street
theme_zh: 几名年轻女子走过蓝色阳光中的城市街道
name: Krenz Cushart
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
